title: Delete the four unused billsplit platform runner directories
objective: billsplit tracked 96 files of flutter create scaffolding across windows/, macos/, ios/ and linux/ that nothing in the repo builds - CI runs analyze and test only, and no script or doc invokes a platform build. One of those files, windows/runner/win32_window.cpp at 288 lines, was the last over-cap C++ file and could not be honestly split because Flutter regenerates it. Deleting the directories removes it from the over-cap list without hand-editing generated code, and takes the repo from 41 over-cap files to 40. Success means the directories and every reference to them are gone, and a future flutter create cannot silently re-track them.
acceptance_criteria: billsplit/windows, billsplit/macos, billsplit/ios and billsplit/linux are removed from git tracking (96 files)
check_file_length.sh --all reports 40 over-cap files, down from 41, with no win32_window.cpp entry
The three referencing sites are updated: .binary-allowlist icon entries removed, .gitignore un-ignore rules removed, README.md Running section corrected
After running flutter create . --platforms=linux,windows,macos,ios for real, git add -An on the four paths adds nothing and reports them as ignored
flutter analyze --fatal-infos, flutter test (60 tests) and dart format --set-exit-if-changed remain green, unchanged from the preceding commit
out_of_scope: billsplit/android/ - the one platform target actually shipped, left tracked
Any change to billsplit/lib/ or billsplit/test/
billsplit/analysis_options.yaml - Flutter tooling rewrites the platform excludes on every analyze run, so removing the dead entries is not durable
The usage_report split work and the bucket_catch eslint errors, both separate commits in this session
verifier: bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all for the over-cap count; cd billsplit && flutter analyze --fatal-infos && flutter test && dart format --set-exit-if-changed . for the CI gates; and flutter create . --platforms=linux,windows,macos,ios followed by git add -An for the resurrection guard, which is the only claim the Flutter gates cannot check.
